content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Bhilai Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 06-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Bhilai recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving applications for the Project Associate and Research Associate positions at IIT Bhilai is 06-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Associate and Research Associate posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies, with 2 for Project Associate and 1 for Research Associate.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: For the Project Associate position, a Diploma in Engineering with 4 years of experience or Engineering/MSc in ECE/EE and allied branches with 2 years of experience is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate post is 50 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Associate position ranges from ₹35,000 to ₹50,000 per month, without HRA.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Interested candidates must apply by sending their application via email to the specified official email address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these roles?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an interview, which can be conducted either online or offline.

faq.question: Q8. Does IIT Bhilai offer age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify details regarding age relaxation for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of IIT Bhilai?
faq.answer: The official website of IIT Bhilai is www.iitbhilai.ac.in.

faq.question: Q10. Are there any application fees for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.
